title: Standards body
description: A standards body: who publishes, where it keeps its register. One _body.yaml in the body's folder; its branches are the folders under it.

name.description: Its name, e.g. Foundry Standards Office.

prefix.description: Its namespace: the start of its standards' ids (FSO). The folder is named after it.

seat.description: Where it sits and keeps its register: a place key, or 'home' (the home system's station).
